subject: Media Literacy
title: Scarcity and Urgency Tactics
description: A quick, practical guide to Scarcity and Urgency Tactics.

hook.text: 'Only 3 left in stock!' You panic-buy something you didn't need five seconds ago.

buildup.text: Scarcity marketing creates urgency by suggesting limited availability or time-sensitive deals.

discovery.text: When something feels scarce, our brain assigns it higher value — even if the scarcity is manufactured.

twist.text: Most 'limited time' offers recur endlessly. The sale that 'ends tonight' returns next week.

climax.text: Urgency bypasses rational thinking. If you feel rushed to buy, that's the strategy, not the reality.

punchline.text: If you have to buy it now, ask why you didn't need it yesterday.

quiz.question: Why do 'limited time' offers work?
options: Perceived scarcity makes our brains assign higher value
